summary: Edgemode, Inc. filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) disclosing that on October 9 and October 14, 2026 it paid approximately $410,000 in cash to fully satisfy five convertible promissory notes carrying an aggregate outstanding balance, including principal and accrued interest, of roughly $477,000; the notes were terminated and conversion rights extinguished. Funding came from advances under the ClearThink Note dated July 9, 2026 and additional ClearThink advances, leaving about $1,300,000 outstanding to ClearThink. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are stated. This is a debt-retirement financing event, not a special situation; watch dilution and related-party financing dependence.
